**Author:** The Milk Man (@MrMilkTrading) · 2026-10-17 · 4 replies, other stats not exposed at capture · received 2026-10-18 (WhatsApp via RDP-30, routed by CoS)

## Summary
Reply to @AEY_Capital's warning that "a lot of people on here sell SPX put spreads" and that this week was a close one. The Milk Man names the alpha source of his free weekly ATR strategy (95% winning weeks since 2020 per AEY_Capital, who rebuilt it back to 2011 on their own option data and "added one…" — quoted text truncated at capture):

- On most weeks, options price an **~8% chance** of closing below **-1 ATR**
- The **actual rate is less than 5%** → those options are typically **overpriced**
- Sell them → win ~95% of the time, but **one loss wipes out weeks of PnL**

## Why it matters
- Names the *mechanism* behind a strategy lineage this vault already tracks: a volatility-risk-premium / tail-mispricing claim, not a technical signal. That makes it directly testable — the 8%-implied vs <5%-actual gap either shows up in the data or it doesn't.
- Corroboration is partial: AEY_Capital independently rebuilt the strategy to 2011 on their own options data, but their tweet truncates at "added one …", and the implied-vs-actual probabilities are the author's claims, not independently shown.
- "This week was a close one" + "one loss wipes out weeks of PnL" is the live warning: a 95% win rate says nothing about risk-adjusted return. The profile is deep negative skew — sizing, not entry, is the survival variable.
